name: Season 29
overview:
Following the departure of host Trevor Noah at the end of 2022, a series of guest hosts from both within and outside "The Daily Show's" correspondents roster filled the program's anchor chair throughout 2023, each sitting in for a one-week assignment.  On January 24, 2024, it was announced that Jon Stewart would return to the show he had hosted from 1999 to 2015.  This time around, in addition to serving as an executive producer, Stewart will host Monday episodes through at least the end of the 2024 U.S. election cycle.

From Tuesdays through Thursdays, members of  "The Best F#@king News Team" will rotate hosting duties.

episodes.name: February 12, 2024 - Zanny Minton Beddoes
episodes.overview: Jon Stewart looks at President Biden and Donald Trump's advanced ages, the news team visits a true American diner, and The Economist's Zanny Minton Beddoes examines national conservatism.

episodes.name: August 12, 2024 - Mark Cuban
episodes.overview: Returning from COVID ("First-timer, did not care for it"), Jon examines Donald Trump's hard time adjusting to Kamala Harris' rising poll numbers, and posits that Trump's use of the same "boilerplate" critiques on Harris that he previously applied to Joe Biden means that Trump desires to see Biden return to the race;[79] Mark Cuban discusses Silicon Valley's love of Trump, the future of AI, and how transparent drug pricing benefits the healthcare system.

episodes.name: August 13, 2024 - Gabby Thomas
episodes.overview: Desi Lydic tackles Donald Trump's glitchy interview with Elon Musk on X, in which a slurring Trump announced plans to close the Department of Education, played '90s pop culture trivia with Vladimir Putin, and revealed his new celebrity crush. On an Olympics edition of Sports War, Ronny Chieng and Michael Kosta recap the biggest stories from the 2024 Paris Games, including why Australian breaker Raygun is sure to be this year's hottest Halloween costume. Also, three-time gold medalist Gabby Thomas joins Desi to discuss her big wins for Team USA, a moment she spent five years training for.

episodes.name: August 14, 2024 - Mark Duplass
episodes.overview: Desi Lydic watches the leaked Project 2025 training videos and discovers the secret right-wing plan for transforming government, undoing climate rules, and eliminating all pronouns from the English language. Plus, the people who made them are a little weird and have close ties to Donald Trump, despite his denials. Grace Kuhlenschmidt explores the drawbacks of having a gerontocracy by chatting with UC Irvine neuropolitics researcher Mark Fisher and visits Congressman Maxwell Frost for a younger politician's perspective. Also, actor, writer, producer, and director Mark Duplass talks to Desi about his second Emmy nomination for his role on the Apple TV+ series "The Morning Show."

episodes.name: August 15, 2024 - Brittney Cooper, Rebecca Traister

episodes.name: August 19, 2024 - Gretchen Whitmer

episodes.name: August 20, 2024 - Rep. Lauren Underwood

episodes.name: August 21, 2024 - Gov. Wes Moore

episodes.overview: Michael Kosta unpacks a whirlwind of pre-election headlines. John Kelly reveals Trump's troubling praise for Hitler. David Hogg, co-founder of March for Our Lives and Leaders We Deserve, discusses his grassroots movement to elect young progressives.

episodes.name: October 24, 2024 - Joseph Antonio Cartagena aka "Fat Joe"
episodes.overview: Michael Kosta breaks down Tucker Carlson's bizarre Trump rally speech. Grammy-nominated artist Joseph Antonio Cartagena aka "Fat Joe" discusses his push for healthcare price transparency, his incredible weight loss journey, and his STARZ series "Fat Joe Talks."

episodes.name: October 28, 2024 - Governor Josh Shapiro
episodes.overview: Jon Stewart dives into Trump's recent xenophobic rally at MSG and his proposed mass deportation plan. Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro discusses the state's role as a "temporary swing state".

episodes.name: October 29, 2024 - María Teresa Kumar
episodes.overview: Ronny Chieng unpacks the fallout from Tony Hinchcliffe's racist joke about Puerto Rico. María Teresa Kumar, President of Voto Latino, joins Ronny to discuss the Latino voting bloc's power.

episodes.name: October 30, 2024 - The Linda Lindas
episodes.overview: Ronny Chieng dives into Biden's "garbage" comment and Trump's surprising plan to let RFK Jr. handle public health. Young rockers "the Linda Lindas" chat about their new album, No Obligation.

episodes.name: October 31, 2024 - Connie Chung
episodes.overview: Ronny Chieng breaks down Trump's garbage truck photo-op and John Leguizamo goes undercover with undecided Latino voters. Trailblazing journalism icon Connie Chung discusses her memoir "Connie".

episodes.name: November 4, 2024 - Adam Serwer
episodes.overview: Jordan Klepper recaps the candidates' final pushes, incl. Kamala Harris' star-studded send-off. Jordan then has a conversation with Adam Serwer, a staff writer for The Atlantic, about MAGA’s conspiracy bubble and GOP “snitch states”.

episodes.name: November 6, 2024 - Tressie McMillan Cottom
episodes.overview: Desi Lydic digests Donald Trump's election win. Tressie McMillan Cottom analyses the election's deeper implications, the rise of identity politics & Trump's appeal to American anxieties.

episodes.name: November 7, 2024 - Emily Ngo
episodes.overview: Ronny Chieng covers Biden's preparations for a peaceful transfer of power, along with Trump's potential cabinet picks. Award-winning journalist Emily Ngo provides her insight on Trump's second win.

episodes.name: November 11, 2024 - Thomas Brennan
episodes.overview: Jon Stewart dissects the Democrat election fallout and what went wrong. Retired Marine Thomas Brennan spotlights the human impact of military service in his film, "Shadows of Fallujah".

episodes.name: November 12, 2024 - Robert Putnam
episodes.overview: Host Jordan Klepper talks with Robert Putnam, a Harvard professor and social scientist, about his documentary "Join or Die."

episodes.name: November 13, 2024 - Moses "Shyne" Barrow Levi
episodes.overview: Jordan Klepper covers Trump's cordial meeting with Biden and his surprising cabinet nominees. Special guest is Moses "Shyne" Barrow, former Grammy-winning rapper turned Belizean political leader.

episodes.name: November 14, 2024 - Francis Ford Coppola
episodes.overview: Host Jordan Klepper interviews Francis Ford Coppola, director of “Megalopolis.”

episodes.name: November 18, 2024 - Ruy Teixeira
episodes.overview: Jon Stewart analyses how Republicans exploit loopholes for political gain while Democrats stick to the rules - is it time for a change in strategy? Host Jon Stewart interviews Ruy Teixeira, founder of The Liberal Patriot and co-author of “Where Have All the Democrats Gone?”

episodes.name: November 19, 2024 - Ronan Farrow
episodes.overview: Desi Lydic dives into explosive allegations vs. Trump's attorney general nominee Matt Gaetz. Award-winning investigative reporter/contributing writer of The New Yorker Ronan Farrow about the new HBO documentary "Surveilled", exposing the perils of spyware.

episodes.name: November 20, 2024 - Joey McIntyre
episodes.overview: Desi Lydic unpacks Trump's latest celebrity cabinet choices, including Dr. Oz and WWE's Linda McMahon. Joey McIntyre of New Kids On The Block discusses his new Christmas film 'Jingle Bell Love'.

episodes.name: November 21, 2024 - Brittany Howard
episodes.overview: Desi Lydic breaks down the latest Washington drama, including Matt Gaetz pulling out of the Attorney General race. Grammy-winning artist Brittany Howard discusses her transformative new album, "What Now".

episodes.name: December 2, 2024 - Sally Yates
episodes.overview: Jon Stewart unpacks Trump's nomination of Kash Patel for FBI head and Biden's pardon of his son Hunter. Former Deputy AG Sally Yates discusses Trump's threat to the DOJ & his "weaponization" of justice.

episodes.name: December 3, 2024 - Neil deGrasse Tyson
episodes.overview: Ronny Chieng tackles South Korea's martial law reversal & misconduct allegations against Pete Hegseth. Astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson shares insights on the contributions of immigrants to science.

episodes.name: December 4, 2024 - Tom Colicchio
episodes.overview: Ronny Chieng breaks down the controversies surrounding Defence Secretary nominee Pete Hegseth, and Josh Johnson covers South Korea's political turmoil. Featured guest is chef & activist Tom Colicchio.

episodes.name: December 5, 2024 - Charles Yu
episodes.overview: Host Ronny Chieng interviews author and creator/executive producer Charles Yu about his book and Hulu series "Interior Chinatown."

episodes.name: December 9, 2024 - Ben Wikler
episodes.overview: Jon Stewart unpacks Syria's revolution & the bizarre capture of an insurance CEO assassin. Ben Wikler, chair of the Wisconsin Democratic Party, discusses his vision for the Democratic party's future.

episodes.name: December 10, 2024 - Deb Haaland
episodes.overview: Michael Kosta tackles the arrest of Luigi Mangione, the suspected United Healthcare CEO assassin, and unpacks America's crush on the "hot felon". Special guest is Interior Secretary Deb Haaland.

episodes.name: December 11, 2024 - T.J. English
episodes.overview: Michael Kosta investigates the manifesto of suspected UHC CEO shooter Luigi Mangione. Author T.J. English chronicles the rise & fall of an American cocaine empire in his latest book, "The Last Kilo".

episodes.name: December 12, 2024 - Peter Sarsgaard
episodes.overview: Michael Kosta covers Time Magazine's half-hearted Person of the Year, "Donald Trump". Actor Peter Sarsgaard discusses his new film "September 5", about the 1972 Munich Olympic terrorist attack.
